tools.name: get_products_from_plati_market
tools.description: Search the plati.market (Digiseller) catalogue and return matching products with their description, prices and the seller offering them. Wraps the 'Items search' API (show=xml&f=7).

tools.name: get_product_from_plati_market
tools.description: Fetch the full description of a single plati.market product plus the seller (id and name) that offers it, by product id. JSON output is requested via response_format=json.
